page.layout: One column of running text. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines they belong to. Running head centred at top, page number at top right. Gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: ta vel crimina dedisse poenarum: reliquis saltem servitio nuper exemptis, parceret. Interea Holofernes Moabitis{a} in deditionem acceptis, atq; adversum Iudæos in so-cieratem belli assumptis, quum ab eorum principibus inquireret, quibusnam viribus freti Hebræi, deditioni animos nō de-Iudith 5. dissent. Accitor quidam comperta edisserit, Iudæos Dei cultores, pio a patribus Achior dux filiorum Ammon.[?]tu institutos, olim in Ægypto pependisse servitium: inde divino munere eductos, Ejus de Iudæis te-limo-nium.ac siccatum{b} mare pedibus emensos: postremo, omnibus gentibus devictis, habitatas{c} majoribus terras recepisse. Exin, vario rerum statu floruisse, aut concidisse atque iterum malis emersisse: secundum merita, iratum ac placatum Deum vicissitudine expertos, dum peccantes incursionibus hostium aut captivitatibus coercentur, propitio numine semper invicti.a addendum videtur, Ammonitis qua.b rubrumc patriarchus Abraham, Isaac & Iacobo.

Ceterum, si præsenti tempore absque peccato sint, nullo modo eos posse superari: sin aliter se habeant, facile vincendos. Ad hæc Holofernes ferox multis victoriis, nihil sibi invictum ratus, ira accensus, cur ex peccato potissimum Iudæorum pede re illius victoria putaretur, propelli Ac-

page.notes: Marginal notes are in the right margin and were placed beside their lines as far as I could judge. Mark "a" after Moabitis, "b" after siccatum and "c" after habitatas are read from small superscript letters in the text. The phrase "pio a patribus ii-tu" is unclear at the line end and is marked [?]. "Ejus de Iudæis te-limo-nium" is partly doubtful. The word "cieratem" in the line "so-cieratem" is doubtful and may be a printing error for societatem; left as printed. "Accitor quidam comperta edisserit" is a doubtful reading of the printed word. The text ends at "Ac-" with a hyphen; no catchword is printed.
